content: बन्धकः .²1 One who binds or catches, a binder. .²2 A catcher. .²3 A band, tie, rope, tether. .²4 A dike, bank, dam. .²5 A pledge, deposit. .²6 A posture of the body. .²7 Barter, exchange. .²8 A violator, ravisher. .²9 A promise. .²10 A city. .²11 A part or portion (at the end of <ab>num.</ab> compounds); ऋणं सदशबन्धकम् <ls>Y. 2. 76</ls>. .{@-कम्@} .²1 Binding, confinement. .²2 Pawn, mortgage; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .{@-की@} .²1 An unchaste woman; न मे त्वया कौमारबन्धक्या प्रयोजनम् <ls>Māl. 7</ls>; <ls>Ve. 2</ls>. .²2 A harlot, courtezan; अतः परं स्वैरिणी स्याद्बन्धकी पञ्चमे भवेत् <ls>Mb. 1. 123. 77</ls>; बलात् धृतोऽसि मयेति बन्धकीधाष्टर्पम् <ls>K. 237</ls>; वैयात्यं प्रथयति बन्धकीव योषा <ls>Rām. Ch. 7. 58</ls>. .²3 A female elephant. .²4 A barren woman.
